summary.text: Sharon Cintolo is the Republican candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 2nd Norfolk District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Tackey Chan.
She was the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2022 and 2024, losing to Chan in both general elections.

paragraphs.text: Sharon Cintolo advanced from the Republican primary for the 2nd Norfolk District on September 6, 2022, and lost the general election that November to Chan, 70.5% to 29.4%.
She ran against him again in 2024, when Chan won 69.4% of the vote to her 30.3%.
She advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.
